开始故事或虚构叙述: Start a story or fictional narrative
从前有一个藏在山间的小村庄。: Once upon a time there was a small village hidden in the mountains.
将故事置于遥远的过去: Set the story in the distant past
很多年前，当我还是个孩子时，我住在一个沿海小镇。: Many years ago, when I was a child, I lived in a coastal town.
指示一系列事件的开始: Indicate the start of a series of events
一切始于我收到姨妈寄来的一封神秘邮件时。: It all started when I received a mysterious email from my aunt.
首先，我准备好了背包并找到了护照。: First, I prepared my backpack and found my passport.
以自白且正式的语气开始叙述: Start narrating in a confessional and formal tone
说实话，一切都始于我马德里前上司一个意想不到的电话。: To be honest, it all started with an unexpected call from my former boss in Madrid.
按时间顺序指示下一个动作: Indicate the next action in chronological order
然后，我迅速出门以免错过火车。: Then, I quickly went out to avoid missing the train.
吃完饭之后，我们去参观了罗马遗迹。: After eating, we went to visit the Roman ruins.
表示动作之间有时间间隔: Indicate a time gap between actions
后来，导游向我们详细解释了城堡的历史。: Later, the guide explained the history of the castle to us in detail.
展示故事的下一个事件: Show the next event in the story
接着，探险队队长向我们展示了那幅古老地图。: Next, the expedition leader showed us the old map.
于是，我决定给她打电话问问发生了什么事。: So, I decided to call her to ask what had happened.
聚焦动作的特定时刻: Focus on a specific moment of the action
就在那一刻，教堂的钟声开始响起。: At that very moment, the church bells began to ring.
以较正式和书面的语气指示随后的事件: Indicate subsequent events in a more formal and written tone
随后，组委会发布了会议的官方纪要。: Subsequently, the organizing committee published the official minutes of the meeting.
突然，天空变黑，开始下起大雨。: Suddenly, the sky turned black and it began to rain heavily.
用转折让读者惊讶: Surprise the reader with a twist
出乎意料地，门突然大开。: Unexpectedly, the door suddenly swung open.
强调某事让角色惊讶: Emphasize something that surprises the character
令所有人惊讶的是，这位老人居然能流利地说三种语言。: To everyone's surprise, the old man could speak three languages fluently.
然而，我们没有雨伞，不得不向一个门廊跑去。: However, we didn't have umbrellas and had to run to a porch.
表示突如其来且令人困惑的转折: Indicate a sudden and confusing turn
突然之间，那辆面包车停在了马路中间。: All of a sudden, the van stopped in the middle of the road.
指示最后一个动作或结果: Indicate the final action or result
最后，经过那么多的努力，我们找到了一个干燥的避难所。: Finally, after so much effort, we found a dry shelter.
以结局结束故事: End the story with an outcome
到最后，原来这只是一个微不足道的小问题。: In the end, it turned out to be just a minor problem.
总之，这次冒险旅行虽然疲惫，但令人难忘。: In short, the adventure trip was tiring but unforgettable.
展示最终的学习或改变: Show the final learning or change
从那天起，我总是在背包里带一幅公路地图。: Since that day, I always carry a road map in my backpack.
提供最终且具有结论性的反思: Provide a final and conclusive reflection
归根结底，我们明白了，正是这些意外让旅行变得与众不同。: In the end, we understood that it is precisely these unexpected events that make a trip different.
序列中的第一个动作: The first action in the sequence

置于特定的过去时间: Set at a specific past time
在那个时候，我还没有太多独自旅行的经验。: At that time, I didn't have much experience traveling alone.
表示某事已发生: Indicate that something had already happened

在我看来，《灵魂迷宫》是今年最成功的电影改编作品之一。依我之见，导演成功地将小说: In my opinion, El laberinto de las almas is one of the most successful film adaptations of the year. In my view, the director has managed to bring the complexity of the novel to the big screen without losing the essence of the story. From my point of view, the best thing without a doubt is the lead performance, especially that of Óscar Martínez as the detective. One strength is also the historical recreation of 1950s Barcelona; the sets and costumes are impeccable. It is worth highlighting the soundtrack, composed specifically for the film, which succeeds in immersing the viewer in the atmosphere of the era. However, the pace of the first forty minutes is somewhat slow for today's audiences, accustomed to more dynamic plots. Even so, from the second act onward, the story becomes so powerful that it is impossible to look away from the screen. On the other hand, the subplot of the historical figure seems somewhat blurred compared to the main line. In my opinion, the main drawback is that the ending is somewhat rushed and seems to resolve too many conflicts in the last ten minutes. Nevertheless, the overall experience is highly satisfying and exciting. In short, it is a film that skillfully blends mystery, love, and historical suspense. I recommend seeing it on the big screen to fully appreciate the spectacular cinematography. Overall, a film worth seeing that leaves a lasting impression.
